summary: setHooksAddress's clear step shr(96, shl(96, x)) keeps bits 96..159 (the low 64 bits of the old address), so setting a second address yields newAddress OR old low 64 bits (e.g. 0x1111...1111 becomes 0x111111111111111111111111BbBbBBbBBBbBBBBb), and via HooksFactory.deployMarketAndHooks a config carrying a stale address makes deployment revert; the only call site takes borrower-supplied input and the top 96 address bits cannot be altered, so impact shown is limited to a failed or misdirected deployment for that borrower.
